system.description: As a Full-Round Action, you allow one Droid that can hear and understand you to take the Full Attack Action. The Droid can replace its relevant Ability Score modifier to its attack roll with your Intelligence modifier.

prerequisite.text: Directed Action talent, Directed Movement talent, and Remote Attack talent
